unit.why: A single anecdote: a disciple troubled by heretical doubts travels to R. Pinhas of Korets, who perceives the doubts through the window and resolves them with one sentence on greeting.

stories.start_quote: רב אחד מתלמידיו הנה ראה כי
stories.end_quote: ותיכף נסע הרב לביתו שלם ברעיוניו
stories.summary_en: A rabbi among R. Pinhas's disciples was tormented by heretical doubts about how God can know human thoughts; when he came to his master, R. Pinhas saw his thoughts through the window and, before he could speak, asked him in Yiddish 'How can God not know, if I know?', and the disciple went home healed in his mind.
